findings.detail: The claimed self-written RTL filename/filelist regression excludes ADC_UPK.v from both SELF_WRITTEN_FILES and EXPECTED_FILELIST_FILES, although rtl/filelist.f correctly includes rtl/ADC_UPK.v and ADC_CHN instantiates ADC_UPK. Running the test directly with python -B fails at line 54 because the expected list omits ADC_UPK.v. This leaves the user-focused self-written unpacker outside the static filename/FSM contract and means the retained static regression is failing rather than passing. Add ADC_UPK.v to both tuples, rerun the static check, and rebuild/review the release baseline; retain its explicit FSM-prefix and naming coverage.

residual_risks: Release baseline integrity recomputation passed for 29 components, and the sidecar binds a fresh VMware run with 19/19 simulation tests passing. Those results do not cover the failing retained static filename/filelist regression. XDC remains DEFERRED_TO_TOP/EXTERNAL_ONLY; VIVADO resolution, VCS/Verdi, XSIM, synthesis, implementation, timing closure and board validation remain NOT_RUN.
